summary: Kit: item creator from the kit, standard titles
author: pm
body:
The tester menu's item creator (sources/client/dialog_box_item_creator.cpp) still has the portrait background and the bitmap-font titles "Create Item" (:265) and "Configure Item" (:357, as of 2026-11-24); screenshots build/screenshots/item_creator_now_*.jpg. User, 2026-11-24: "Yes, do it" (asked whether to convert it like the tester menu, HH-0072).

Convert both pages to a kit frame with no picture and the standard kit title. The dropdowns, the search list, click rects and behaviour stay unchanged, and the old-sprite fallback stays.

**Done when:** bridge screenshots of both pages (and the open dropdown) show the kit frame and title, both builds are clean, and the review passes.

Source: chat, 2026-11-24.

Verified: read-only review PASS; builds clean; bridge screenshots hh0076_item_creator_search/configure/configure_dropdown.jpg show the kit frame and titles.

comments.author: client
comments.body: Done, uncommitted, checkpoint 5cb3d8b1 (dialog_box_item_creator.cpp). Kit frame as the tester menu's (kit_layout::tall_size / tall_panel), title drawn once in on_draw: "Create Item" / "Configure Item" at y 20 with the standard flourishes; the two Bitmap1 page titles removed; fallback keeps the sprite frame and Bitmap1 title. Dropdowns, list, click rects unchanged. Shots: build/screenshots/hh0076_item_creator_{search,configure,configure_dropdown}.jpg (before: item_creator_now_*.jpg).
